visual_goal: Show Runway as a hub that drives each control-plane service through its onboarding step without owning their data.
prompt: A hub-and-spoke illustration. At the far left, a signed paper contract labeled 'Signed contract' with one arrow into a large central control-panel hub labeled 'Runway'. Around the right half of the hub, seven generic service boxes arranged in an arc, each connected from the hub by one outgoing arrow: 'Tenant directory' at top, 'Axleby ID', 'DMS adapter', 'Migration toolkit', 'Relay', 'Baseline', and 'Billing' at the bottom. Only two arrows carry labels: the arrow into 'Migration toolkit' labeled 'import', and the arrow into 'Relay' labeled 'hand-over'. Each service box has a small padlock showing it keeps its own data. These eleven labels are the only words in the image.
alt: A signed contract feeds Runway, which sends arrows to the tenant directory, Axleby ID, the DMS adapter, the migration toolkit, Relay, Baseline and billing.

visual_goal: Show a rooftop's onboarding as a state machine: authority and integration in parallel, repeatable migration, reversible hand-over.
prompt: A left-to-right state map of eight rounded tiles. Far left: blue 'Contracted'. One arrow to blue 'Provisioned'. From 'Provisioned' two arrows fan out to two parallel tiles stacked vertically: teal 'Authorized' above and teal 'Integrated' below. From each of these one arrow converges into orange 'Ready to migrate'. One arrow from 'Ready to migrate' to green 'Reconciled', labeled 'dealer signs'. One curved return arrow below from 'Reconciled' back to 'Ready to migrate', labeled 're-import'. One arrow from 'Reconciled' to green 'Channels live'. One curved return arrow below from 'Channels live' back to 'Reconciled', labeled 'roll back'. One arrow from 'Channels live' to a dark green tile at the far right labeled 'Live'. These twelve labels are the only words in the image.
alt: States Contracted, Provisioned, Authorized and Integrated in parallel, Ready to migrate, Reconciled, Channels live and Live, with return arrows for re-import and roll back.

visual_goal: Show migration as a re-runnable pipeline: staging, VIN resolution, validation, a dealer work queue loop, and a reconciliation the dealer signs against the DMS feed.
prompt: A left-to-right pipeline illustration. Each label appears exactly once, placed directly beneath its icon. Far left: a stack of export files with the label 'Vendor export' once below it. One arrow into a tray labeled 'Staging'. One arrow into a magnifier over a car silhouette labeled 'Resolve VIN'. One arrow into a checklist box labeled 'Validate'. From 'Validate' two arrows: one to the right, green, labeled 'clean', into a database cylinder with the single label 'Stock' below it; one downward, orange, labeled 'flagged', into an inbox labeled 'Dealer queue'. One curved arrow along the bottom from 'Dealer queue' back to 'Staging', labeled 'corrected'. One arrow from 'Stock' to the right into a clipboard report labeled 'Reconciliation'. Directly below 'Reconciliation', a second input box labeled 'DMS feed' with one arrow pointing straight up into 'Reconciliation', not into 'Stock'. One final arrow from 'Reconciliation' to a green tick seal, labeled 'signed'. These twelve labels are the only words in the image and none is repeated.
alt: Vendor export flows through staging, VIN resolution and validation; clean records go to stock and flagged ones to a dealer queue that loops back; stock and the DMS feed meet in a reconciliation that is signed.

visual_goal: Show configuration resolving down a hierarchy from market pack to user, with a group lock and a versioned snapshot stamped on decisions.
prompt: A top-to-bottom layered illustration on the left half: five stacked horizontal slabs, widest at top, each with one downward arrow to the next: 'Market pack' at top, then 'Group policy', then 'Region', then 'Rooftop', then 'User'. A padlock icon on a curved orange arrow from 'Group policy' that skips 'Region' and points to 'Rooftop', labeled 'lock'. From 'Rooftop' one arrow to the right into a camera-snapshot card labeled 'Snapshot'. From 'Snapshot' one arrow further right into three small decision cards grouped together and labeled 'Decisions', the arrow labeled 'version id'. These nine labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Market pack, group policy, region, rooftop and user stacked top to bottom, with a group lock on the rooftop; the rooftop's effective snapshot is stamped with a version id on decisions.
